status: registered experimental protocol; not production approved
computational_protocol: samo-ecology-v4, byte-for-byte wrapped; compute RNG and selection are invariant
terminology: bounded archive-based diversity search; no fitness elite is selected, therefore not MAP-Elites
inheritance: v2 morphology descends from actual current computational parent at each accepted birth; morphology founders use founder_v2 and an independent seeded RNG
archive_policy: up to 64 descriptor-cell occupancy records; no genotypes, no donor use, no revival of extinct lines
proposal_policy: all arms create and develop four mutations per accepted birth; neutral samples one, novelty maximizes nearest distance to active descriptors, archive-diversity favors the least occupied archived niche; ties use registered morphology RNG
phenotype_niches: descriptor bins for decorative nodes, spatial span, branch count and shape types
selection: computational v4 selection unchanged; morphology score never enters prediction fitness, evaluation, or parent selection
recolonization: v4 registered fresh computational founders; independently generated v2 morphology founder genomes; archived genotypes never reintroduced

retention.older_event_policy: hash-chain pruning summary; preserve original v5 and pilot archives

claims: No improvement is guaranteed. Morphology diversity is not predictive capability; computational efficacy remains independently measured by v4 results.
